notes.title: Boot Hill Blaster!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242825/10d46874e96163206aad92af934a9ed330f2a24d.jpg[/img]

Get your trusty blaster ready because Boot Hill Blaster is coming to Steam on November 9th!  Enjoy endless fast-paced arcade action, retro graphics, and an original chiptune soundtrack!

[h1]Story[/h1]

You wake up in a desert cemetery one night. You don't remember how you got here, but something feels wrong about the place.

The ground begins to shake and you suddenly find yourself in a fight for your life against a swarm of deadly monsters.

How long can you survive this night of terror?

http://store.steampowered.com/app/743660/Boot_Hill_Blaster/
